how many input channels the model reads. 1 = speed only, 11 = everything

trainable parameters. All models are within 20% of each other, so nothing here is won by size
average error when predicting 15 minutes ahead. LOWER IS BETTER

error only during rain (>=0.51 mm). 51 rain spells across the three test blocks

error only in the hour after a big fixture ends. NOTE: this reads LOW for everyone because egress is 21:30-23:00 on an empty road, not because events are easy
does the model reproduce a shockwave travelling BACKWARDS along the road? Observed reality = 1.683. 1.0 would mean the model has no sense of direction at all. HIGHER IS BETTER
spread of that ratio over the 9 runs (3 folds x 3 seeds)
